text:
alex: FYI opened docs PR for "local" HSM emulation guidance for air-gapped installs — trying to capture SoftHSM steps + a clear note that LocalStack is NOT suitable for production HSMs. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 :wave:

maria: Thanks! quick nit — can we include a minimal systemd unit for SoftHSM so folks can run it as a service? most customers on-prem expect that.

alex: good call. adding a snippet now. also added a short migration note for customers who used the old "dev-hsm" recipes.

tayla: skimming the PR — please add a clear warning about PKCS#11 key IDs changing when you reinitialize SoftHSM. That caused a support ticket last month. maybe a small troubleshooting section?

alex: yep adding a "rekey" troubleshooting tip and example command.

samir: re: LocalStack — +1 to not recommending it. we should mention that LocalStack emulates KMS API but does not provide PKCS#11 behavior and can give false confidence for integration tests. short paragraph should do.

maria: snippet for systemd (put this after the install steps):

```
[Unit]
Description=SoftHSM v2 service for dev environment
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label "redwood-dev" || /usr/bin/softhsm2 -f
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

alex: added that exact block, thanks. also added env var examples for the installer config: `HSM_PROVIDER=pkcs11`, `SOFTHSM2_CONF=/etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf`.

dev-docs-bot: CI lint report — docs PR #5123 has 1 link-check failure (internal link to /private/install/hsm -> 404). See: https://ci.redwood/5123/logs

alex: fixing link now — it should point to /private/install/hsm-quickstart. thanks bot.

tayla: small UX ask — can we add a preflight checkbox in the "air-gapped prerequisites" list: "HSM emulator required for local QA: SoftHSM v2 (not LocalStack)". helps SEs know to run tests locally.

alex: added the checklist item and a short smoke-test section with commands:

```bash
# init token
softhsm2-util --init-token --slot 0 --label redwood-test --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678
# verify slot
softhsm2-util --show-slots
# run quick integration test
REDWOOD_HSM_PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so ./bin/redwood-kms-check --pkcs11
```

samir: can you also include a note about PKCS11 module path differences on Debian vs RHEL? we had a bug where installer assumed `/usr/lib` but on RHEL it's `/usr/lib64`.

alex: added that note and small code sample to detect both paths in the installer docs.

maria: editorial: change "emulator" -> "SoftHSM (emulated PKCS#11 provider)" in headings so customers don't confuse with prod HSMs.

alex: done. pushed update.

dev-docs-bot: CI status — link-check fixed; docs build green except for one lint rule: `docs/no-encouraged-insecure-emulation` flagged phrase "use LocalStack for KMS testing" (line 72). Please reword or cite as discouraged.

alex: updated wording to "LocalStack can be useful for AWS KMS API-level tests, but it does not emulate PKCS#11 or HSM semantics. Do not use as a stand-in for on-prem HSM testing."

tayla: looks good to me. ran the smoke commands locally and they work. :thumbsup:

samir: +1, minor docstyle nit inline. after that we can merge.

alex: thanks all — I'll address the nit and merge on green. adding a followup to backport the checklist to the Private installer quickstart.

maria: awesome, thanks for taking this on.

dev-docs-bot: Merge queued for PR #5123 — auto-merge on successful CI.
